title: New-grad full-stack TypeScript engineer, remote SaaS
jd:

title: Junior full-stack developer, Django, Bangkok edtech startup
jd:
Junior Full-Stack Developer (Django)
Kru Online - Bangkok

About us
Kru Online runs live and recorded tutoring for Thai high-school students. More than 400,000 learners use our platform to prepare for university entrance exams, and our engineering team of 15 is growing.

The role
You will work on our Django monolith, building features for students, tutors and parents. Day to day that means designing models and REST endpoints with Django REST Framework, writing server-rendered templates and small JavaScript widgets, and keeping the PostgreSQL queries behind them fast during exam season.
You will write automated tests for what you build and take part in code review through Git.

What we need
You should be comfortable with Python and Django and know your way around HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
You understand how REST APIs work and have used PostgreSQL or another relational database.
We hire final-year students and new graduates.

Nice to have
Experience with background jobs using Celery and Redis, a React frontend, Docker, or deploying to Kubernetes will help you settle in faster, but we will teach you.

title: React Native mobile intern, Bangkok parking startup
jd:
Jodrod is a Bangkok startup that helps drivers find and pay for parking in condos, malls and office buildings.
We are looking for a React Native intern to join our mobile squad for a full semester.

You will build new screens in our React Native app, which is written in TypeScript.
You will connect those screens to our REST APIs for bookings, payments and parking-lot availability.
You will also fix bugs reported by drivers and help improve app start-up time.
Later in the internship you will help us add push notifications for booking reminders.

We would like you to have solid JavaScript and TypeScript.
You should have built at least one React Native app yourself; a class project counts.
You should have experience calling REST APIs and use Git every day.

It is a plus if you have used Redux for state management, Firebase for push notifications or analytics, or Jest for unit tests.
If you have ever written a native module in Swift or Kotlin, tell us about it.

We offer a monthly allowance, a MacBook for the internship, and a mentor from our senior mobile team.
To apply, send your resume and a link to your GitHub or an app store listing.

title: Junior design engineer, Figma + React, remote scheduling SaaS
jd:
Design Engineer (Junior) - Remote
Fernway

Fernway makes scheduling software for clinics and studios, with customers in 30 countries. Our design system is used by 40 engineers across 6 product squads, and we are hiring our first junior design engineer to help it grow.

What you'll do
You will sit between design and engineering. Some weeks you will be in Figma refining components and tokens with our designers; other weeks you will be building those same components in React and TypeScript, documenting them in Storybook and making sure they work for keyboard and screen-reader users.
You will also prototype new interaction ideas quickly, so the team can test them with real customers before committing to a full build.

What we're looking for
Strong Figma skills, including auto layout, variants and design tokens.
Solid HTML and CSS, plus working experience with React and TypeScript.
A real interest in accessibility; you should know what WCAG asks for.
A portfolio that shows both design work and shipped code.

Bonus
Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion or Next.js experience.
Usability testing experience is welcome too.
